description: Agent Hiring: submit a reference record with the application and the work record it supports: the reference with the candidate it speaks for, the referee, the relationship (manager, client, colleague, direct report or other), the engagement it cites, the organization, the candidate’s role as the referee states it and the start and end days; the application with the candidate and each referee listed with the relationship and the engagement; and the work record with each engagement’s organization, role and days. The signed report gives the reference, the referee as the application lists them, the engagement the reference supports, and the organization, the role and the dates on each side with their overlap in days, and counts them, and names a discrepant reference: a reference for another candidate, a relationship unlike the application lists, no engagement in the work record behind it, another organization or role than the work record shows, and dates outside the engagement; then a referee the application does not list, another engagement than the listing and dates that overlap but differ, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No referee, no engagements, no relationship, role or complete dates leaves the reference unverified. It reads the record as presented; it contacts no one. Referees and organizations read without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, and roles with their common short forms spelled out. Beside it, wever_testimonial-evidence-check reads attributed quotes or endorsements word by word against their source material, and wever_delegate-vetting-check reads how a delegator checked a delegate’s identity, track record and fit before an authority grant, while the reference check reads a referee’s name, relationship, engagement dates and role against the application and the work record. Verdict hire_reference_discrepant, hire_reference_partial, hire_reference_unverified or hire_reference_consistent. POST /api/hire-reference-check. Reads the hiring paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no judgment of whether a candidate is good, qualified in substance or worth hiring, no background check, no contact with referees or issuers, no verification with outside sources and no employment-law advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Hiring reads supplied hiring paperwork for consistency between documents: a hiring brief, a credential record, a portfolio or past-work record, a reference, a rate quote, an engagement contract, an availability commitment and a payment setup. Beside it, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job and the other tools of the intent job kit are the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, and wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork before anything is committed; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-hiring-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-hiring/.
